industry_specific_challenges: Emotional nature of pet health decisions
High no-show rates for wellness visits
Competition from low-cost clinics and online pharmacies
Communicating complex medical info to pet parents

pain_points.name: Low Wellness Visit Compliance
pain_points.description: Pet owners don't bring pets in for regular checkups and preventive care
pain_points.impact: 40-60% of pets overdue for wellness visits, missing early disease detection
pain_points.ai_potential: Automated multi-channel recall campaigns increase compliance by 20-30%

pain_points.name: Appointment No-Shows
pain_points.description: Clients miss appointments without notice, leaving gaps in schedule
pain_points.impact: 10-20% no-show rate costs €300-600/day in lost revenue
pain_points.ai_potential: Automated reminders + easy rescheduling reduce no-shows by 30-50%

pain_points.name: After-Hours Emergency Handling
pain_points.description: Emergency calls after hours need triage but staff unavailable
pain_points.impact: Missing emergencies damages reputation; unnecessary ER referrals frustrate clients
pain_points.ai_potential: AI triage + routing captures emergencies and handles routine queries 24/7

pain_points.name: Clinical Documentation Burden
pain_points.description: Vets spend significant time on notes, reducing patient care time
pain_points.impact: 30-60 minutes/day on documentation per vet, contributing to burnout
pain_points.ai_potential: AI-assisted SOAP notes reduce documentation time by 50%+
